svg.font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'Malgun Gothic', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Playing in three steps. Install: run openDMT3-win-Setup.exe, which installs for your Windows user without administrator rights. DISC CHECK: the launcher finds your client data and says what it is, here made-up client data in a folder that is ready, with its PC client, songs and jackets. PLAY: your card goes in and the game starts.
